Description: Aggregate result tables and records accompanying the BlindVision evaluation.

data/raw/participant_trials_breakdown.csv contains seven tester rows (P01-P07) totaling 100 navigation trials and 96 successful trials. It is a per-tester breakdown, not a listing of the visually impaired participants; see data/raw/README.md.
data/raw/participant_trial_outcomes_100.csv contains the 100 trial-level outcomes for the same tester pool (96 successful, 4 unsuccessful).

Heldout_Test.csv contains the reported held-out detection metrics (Table II); Confusion_Matrix.csv contains the ten-class confusion matrix (Table IV); Classwise_Evaluation.csv contains per-class counts, precision and recall recomputed from that matrix.
Complete image/label data, trained weights, epoch-wise training logs, per-class AP values, and raw row-level prediction logs are not included in this release.
